title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as ridge regression, tends to shrink the coefficients of less important features towards zero, but not exactly zero. It helps in reducing model complexity and multicollinearity.

title: Comparing the Versions
text: Look at the coefficients in each version. L2 regularization usually results in smaller coefficients compared to no regularization and L1 regularization.

title: Identifying the Optimal Parameters
text: Which version has coefficients that are small but not zero? This is a characteristic of L2 regularization.
